facts.fact: The report says two false-publication sections of Kenya's Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act were struck down by the Court of Appeal, and that a 2025 amendment to the Act was partly struck down in a later challenge, so the Act otherwise stands; published 2026-07-28, no event date given.

note: No use fact: staff and defenders being followed and summoned for questioning under the law is undated and not an arrest or charge; court rulings are not penalties imposed by the body the law sets up.
